name: tract_developer_pass_budget
description: Test 3, by hand from 4.3. Residential developer, tract size 4, demand 1000 (desired 1000, desiredMax 1500), maxStage 1 (so the strict check 7 of 4.7 never applies: stage 1 is not < 1). Part 1: the scripted lot developer does not change the lot's state, so every pass finds the same empty 1 x 1 lot, builds a capacity-10 building on it and ends at its success without reaching desired: passesLeft 17 -> -1 gives exactly 18 passes, 18 outcomes 27 and built 180. Each pass draws R1 (one rand(); start = rand() mod 16 from state 1: 9, 3, 14, 4, 1, 12, 6, 14, 2, 0, 9, 1, 1, 11, 9, 11, 3, 6), then PickBuilding's R4 = RandomUint32Uniform(1) and R5 = RandomUint32Uniform(1) (no style map, so no R3). The out flag is set (an existing lot not in state 3 that does not fail with 6). Part 2: StartConstruction now puts lots in state 2. Two empty lots: pass 1 builds the first (equal scores 0 keep list order), pass 2 finds the first in state 2 (code 4) and builds the second, pass 3 has no candidate: best = max(1 takeover, 4 existing, 5 aggregation (equal sizes count 5), 4 subdivision) = 5 is pushed and, from pass 2 on, a pass without success ends the call: outcomes [27, 27, 5], built 20; row 0 of the histogram counts the one empty pass with 5. rand() continues: 11, 12, 7.
